title: Retry / resume
summary: Resuming a failed run restores the QA copies its failure retired only for shared rows and current members. Removing a member takes over its copies the failure retired, so a removed member's QA never returns to hold the run. A stage dispatch refused as run_busy, lock_timeout or statement_cancelled is not a failure: the driver re-dispatches it on its 15-second check, repeats other busy calls after 15s, 30s, then 60s, and past that cap stops with deployment_run_stayed_busy, leaving the run unchanged for `yoke watch deploy -- RUN-ID`.
